sources_read: rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx: Quality Checks row 26 and Internal Quality Checks row 26 (Mukesh flow annotation); rows 1, 25, 32, 35 wording
rules/harbor-webdev-rubric-qc/SKILL.md (verdicts, known false positives incl. checks 26/28/33 flow bundling)
evidence: Built the requirement->criterion map over instruction.md and all six notes against the 52 criteria. Nearly every stated behaviour maps to a criterion: custom surface (constraints cw_custom_document_surface), typing/Backspace/Delete/arrows/Home/End/line+column from one (cw_custom_typing_and_line_join, cw_caret_navigation_and_line_numbers), Ctrl+Home/End and auto-scroll (cw_caret_kept_in_view), graphemes, mouse gestures/copy, replace-on-type/paste and one-step paste undo, Tab/Shift+Tab incl. single-line and next-line-start cases, Alt+Click and Ctrl/Cmd+Click multi-caret typing/Backspace/Delete/same-line, slow-burst single undo/redo, undo caret restore, disabled Undo/Redo after New/open, Find/Replace current/all incl. literal dot/bracket, wrap, self-containing replacement, redo cleared, JS/HTML colouring, JS/HTML format + idempotence (second Format adding no undo step is caught because one Undo must return to the original), format syntax error, Run JS/HTML incl. onclick, fresh document, console order, thrown and rejected errors with one-based and whole-file lines, syntax error keeps draft, output kept after throw/timeout/stop, last-good incl. typed field and canvas, interaction budget, time limit, Stop cancelling timer/interval/Promise, newer run supersedes, preview isolation (parent DOM/title, localStorage, fetch to localhost and 127.0.0.1), dynamic code refused with string/comment control, plain-text save, shared server-backed library, restart, stale save refused and draft kept, live library, live refresh preserving draft/caret/scroll/undo/fields, newer-revision notice, read-only history, restore adds revision, old-page restore cannot overwrite, visible HTTP restore and repeat-safe replay; polish covers keyboard reach/focus/escape shortcut on screen, feedback in words, focus return after Format/Undo/Redo/Replace all/Save, dirty marker incl. undo-to-saved, 390 px. Integration items (port, DB_PATH, SQLite, symlinks) are template runtime contract enforced by test.sh launch with DB_PATH and readiness probe, not browser-gradable, consistent with REVIEW_POLICY. BLOCKING GAP introduced by 5e036ba0: behaviour.md:9 'my saved snippets and their history need to survive a full server restart' and behaviour.md:13 'Looking at history ... shows that snapshot's title, filename and code'. cw_save_reload_restart now makes revision 3 a restore of revision 1, so the current source equals revision 1's source; after restart it re-reads only the current source, the revision list and revision 1's source. Revision 2's source (the only distinct non-current snapshot) is never re-read after the restart, and the one history-content leg that remains (revision 1) is indistinguishable from the current source. Before 5e036ba0 the current source was revision 2, so re-reading revision 1 discriminated. The scripted golden test is stronger than the criterion again: persist.cjs asserts 'every revision keeps its own source after the restart' over all codes, while the criterion text does not; this is the same issue-4 pattern (row 35) the commit meant to close. The orchestrator's description 're-reads all three revisions' does not match the criterion text. Pattern checks: row 25 - no public or off-machine URL anywhere in tests or notes; only localhost/127.0.0.1 (app_context.md:'No criterion needs any address outside this machine'); clean. Row 32 - all four Stop/race legs (cw_output_before_failure_kept, cw_last_good_recovery, cw_stop_cancels_pending_work, cw_newer_run_supersedes) now carry the same defined void rule (void, up to two more attempts, fail only if all void); cw_preview_isolation defines 'repeat it once'; no undefined repeats remain; the void rule is distinct from the functional prompt's 'two failed attempts' fail-fast because void attempts are declared 'not a failure'. Row 1 - notes are first-person prose with no numbered acceptance lists; ui.md and behaviour.md remain dense with edge cases but read as a person's request; residual reviewer-variance risk only. Looser for the model: (a) the restart regression above; (b) newer-run retries went from 2 to 3 attempts, which only affects void judge-timing attempts, not app correctness, so not looser for a broken app. Minor non-blocking coverage notes: Ctrl+A is graded only indirectly (cw_newer_run_supersedes procedure: if select-all fails, the old draft re-runs and its old marker appears, failing that criterion, which conflates two promises); Shift+Tab one-undo-step, same-line multi-caret Delete, Promise-callback budget, and Replace current focus return are not separately exercised; live-library and newer-revision windows allow ten seconds against 'about five seconds' in behaviour.md:11.
counterexample: App stores revision metadata and the current source in SQLite but keeps per-revision snapshot bodies in an in-memory map, and when a snapshot body is missing (after restart) the history view shows the snippet's current source. After restart: current revision 3 source correct, revision list 1-3 correct, revision 1 shows current source which equals revision 1's original source -> criterion passes, yet revision 2's source is lost, violating behaviour.md:9/13. Pre-5e036ba0 this app failed because the current source was revision 2.
suggested_fix: In cw_save_reload_restart, after the restart also open revision 2 in history and require its exact source with the second marker (and add 'if revision two's source differs after the restart' to the fail list), matching persist.cjs's every-revision assertion.
